_comment: Heterogeneous FireSim schedule: periodic dronet at period=50ms (vs the 200ms variant in networks_periodic_dronet_yolov8_firesim.json) + non-periodic yolov8_nano on the dual-rocket-saturn-gemmini bitstream. With yolov8's no-contention greedy makespan ≈ 141ms (gemmini hart at 110ms is the bottleneck; per-op routing drops total work from gemmini-standalone 422ms via faster RVV silu/sigmoid LUTs), a 50ms dronet period fits ceil(141/50)=3 instances within yolov8's window — exercises overlapping cross-kind dispatch (dronet dispatches arriving every 50ms while yolov8 is mid-inference). Same hardware setup as the 200ms variant: cpu_p=gemmini@hart0, cpu_e=RVV@hart1, profile_target=firesim_rocket_saturn, topo_0. Profile data shared with sweep_v8 — see zephyr-chipyard-sw/agents/notes/firesim_sweep_v8_results.md.
